headline: Nifty snaps four-day winning streak as Sensex falls 330 points amid expiry volatility

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty snapped its 4-day winning streak, closing at 23,329 due to pressure on F&O expiry day.
Sensex dropped over 300 points following afternoon market volatility and CAS indicative price drops.
Investors kept track of shifting crude oil prices and global cues including US-Iran talks.
Foreign exchange intervention and RBI bond sales influenced currency stability and market cash overhang.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 329 to 330 points lower while Nifty closed below the 23,350 mark.
LIC is reported to lead bidding in NSE's Rs 22,800 crore initial public offering.
Samsung India reported a 36% decline in FY26 profit to ₹7,228 crore despite a 1.2% rise in revenue.
SEBI highlighted potential for Rs 2 lakh crore in IPO fundraising as fresh capital gains prominence.
summary: Indian benchmark indices snapped a four-day winning streak on Tuesday, with the Sensex falling 330 points and Nifty closing below 23,350. Volatility on the F&O expiry day and crude oil fluctuations kept market sentiment cautious. Meanwhile, LIC is reported to lead bidding for NSE's landmark Rs 22,800 crore IPO.
